Deprecated name for load_genotypes()

Source: R/pop_structure.R
run_ld_prune.Rd

run_ld_prune() was renamed to load_genotypes(): the old name reads oddly for what it mostly does, and reads as a contradiction with prune = FALSE. Kept so existing scripts keep working.

Usage

run_ld_prune(...)

Arguments

...

Passed to load_genotypes().

Value

See load_genotypes().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# deprecated: use load_genotypes()
geno <- run_ld_prune("clean.vcf.gz", gds = "clean.gds")
} # }
